jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit INPUT1 (two figures of the brown carrier outfit) non-destructively.
FIX ONLY the left figure's chest strap/arm occlusion. A diagonal brown carry strap with pale buckle is incorrectly painted OVER the bent foreground forearm and sleeve. Put that strap physically ON THE TORSO BEHIND the bent arm. Remove the diagonal strap and buckle pixels from the entire visible foreground brown sleeve between elbow and wrist. Restore one continuous broad muted brown sleeve plane there, matching the right figure's clean foreground sleeve. The strap can be visible on upper chest above the arm and on the torso below the arm, but disappears where the arm occludes it. It must never cross the hand or extend over its outside edge.
Keep the left hand, wrist, elbow positions EXACTLY where they are. Keep right figure entirely unchanged. Keep helmet, face, body silhouette, brown coat, tall backpack, cargo pockets, boots, cell layout, scale and existing pixel style unchanged. INPUT2 is approved C style reference only; do not recolor the coat or redesign the body. Preserve true transparent background and same canvas. No guns, labels, new accessories, fine detail or added thick outlines.
jobs.repair_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Target is this transparent two-figure brown carrier outfit sheet. Change ONLY the RIGHT FIGURE's bent foreground sleeve: remove the entire diagonal carry strap and pale buckle crossing that sleeve. Replace that diagonal strip with the same plain brown cloth as the rest of the sleeve, so the near arm is one clean uninterrupted brown elbow-to-wrist shape. Let the chest strap be hidden BEHIND this arm. The LEFT figure already has the correct clean brown sleeve and must remain exactly unchanged. RIGHT hand/arm positions must stay exactly the same; preserve the downward two-handed grip, both hands, face, helmet, long coat, pockets, backpack, legs, boots, palette, pixel clusters and canvas. Do not move the diagonal strip onto the left sleeve. Neither sleeve should have a strap crossing it. No gun, background or text; preserve actual transparency.

jobs.detail: Preserve ochre shoulder fire-resistant cape/yoke, navy coat and trousers, rust neck scarf, navy lamp helmet, grey rectangular vented back canister with only three broad slots, and two dull olive utility pouches. Reduce dense black edges into blue-grey and ochre material-colored shadows. Do not add shiny armor.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / outfit style unification. One concept sheet for an existing game.
INPUT1 is a TWO-figure sheet: authoritative target for BODY PROPORTIONS, pixel-cluster scale, muted grouped values, restrained contours AND EXACT CURRENT ONE-HAND AND TWO-HAND IDLE POSES.
INPUT2 is the EXISTING OUTFIT sprite atlas: preserve its outfit identity, unique helmet if present, clothing palette, backpack/gear silhouette. Use only its TOP-LEFT idle figure for garment design; do not reproduce the atlas or other actions.
INPUT3 is the approved C hero: additional authority for subdued material-colored contours and large flat pixel masses.
Edit INPUT1's clothing to the input2 outfit, rendering both figures as the same person and same outfit. Result remains EXACTLY TWO FIGURES side-by-side on transparent background, wide2:1 PNG approximately1774x887. Equal square cells, same scale/baseline as input1, face RIGHT in same three-quarter side view. No labels, guns, ground, shadows, halos or background. Keep same helmet-to-boot proportions as input1 (except distinctive sealed helmet where specified).
LEFT retains input1 onehand idle: near hand bent at lower sternum for pistol, other hand hanging low. RIGHT retains input1 TWO-HAND LOW READY idle: trigger hand at lower sternum and support hand farther right AND BELOW it, with both hands forming a line sloping DOWN RIGHT about30degrees. Arms do not rise into aiming pose. Exactly two hands, preserve their relative position and elbows. Guns will be composited later.
Style lock: broad coherent pixel clusters, quiet large cloth masses, two or three grouped values per material, selective muted outline only at overlaps; no continuous thick black border, fine outlines, grain, dithering, small bolts, piping or bright bevels. No optical blur or smooth gradients. Outfit straps/cables attach to torso behind sleeves and hands, no harness drawn over foreground bent forearm. Both halves retain identical head and outfit identity; only arms differ.
OUTFIT: Preserve ochre shoulder fire-resistant cape/yoke, navy coat and trousers, rust neck scarf, navy lamp helmet, grey rectangular vented back canister with only three broad slots, and two dull olive utility pouches. Reduce dense black edges into blue-grey and ochre material-colored shadows. Do not add shiny armor.

jobs.detail: Preserve navy coat, rust neck scarf, off-white wide lifting harness and a substantial round cable reel on the back with sparse simple frame, two dull olive squared cargo pouches at hips, navy lamp helmet. Keep reel silhouette and harness distinguishing this outfit; do not add random mechanism detail or dangling straps. Harness is ON TORSO behind both arms, never across forearm or hand.
